deployments_detail.use: SPOT (Sepsis Prediction and Optimization of Therapy): real-time algorithm ingesting vital signs, labs and nursing reports to flag sepsis roughly 6-18 hours earlier than clinicians; deployed at scale across the hospital network and credited with saving lives. deployments_detail.value: Used with ~2.5M patients; estimated ~8,000 lives saved over five years; deployed across 173 hospitals; sepsis mortality reduction cited at 22.9%
